npcs.name: Tomas Fell
npcs.idle: I'm an apprentice. Apprentices do as they're told. Mostly.

npcs.name: Hrodda Alreksdottir
npcs.idle: Your people think mine are animals. Mine think yours are. Both are mostly right, this season.

npcs.name: Captain Mardoc
npcs.idle: Hill raiders, smugglers, and now red robes. This posting gets better every week.

npcs.name: Castellan Rhydderch
npcs.idle: Swanton holds the north road. Dinas Emrys holds the west. One of those is ours.

npcs.name: Taliesin the Bard
npcs.idle: I sang at Arthur's court. I'll sing at his waking, if I live. That's what bards are for.

quests.title: The Last Shift
quests.offer:
My master, Magus Idris, wants a cockatrice egg from the old mine in the hills. I was meant to fetch it. I - didn't. I sat in the tavern instead.

And Mabli - she's the miller's girl, she's not afraid of anything - she said she'd go for me so I wouldn't lose my place. That was yesterday morning. Please, will you [go after her]? I'll owe you forever. I already owe her forever.
quests.summary: Mabli Trewin went to the haunted mine for a cockatrice egg, in place of the apprentice too frightened to go.

steps.goal: Search the path to the old mine
steps.text: A salt circle, scuffed open. Someone sat in it for a long while. Cockatrice tracks all round, and further up, the sound of picks where nobody has dug for two centuries.

steps.goal: Clear the cockatrices from the mine mouth
steps.text: Past the nests, lamplight flickers in the shaft - pale, cold lamplight.

steps.goal: Find Mabli in the mine
steps.say: Oh, thank the gods - no, keep your voice down. They're not cruel, the miners. They just don't know they're dead. They gave me a pick and told me to dig, and the foreman won't let anyone leave before the [shift bell].

steps.goal: End the last shift
steps.text: The ghost foreman lets go of the bell-rope. It rings once, very far away, and the miners lay down their picks and walk into the rock, one after another, going home.

stages.name: Foreman Gethin of the Last Shift
stages.objective: Make Foreman Gethin ring the bell
stages.announce: A great grey man with a lamp comes out of the dark. 'Back to work. No one leaves before the bell.'

boss.name: Foreman Gethin of the Last Shift

stages.success: Foreman Gethin of the Last Shift falls.

steps.goal: Talk to Mabli
steps.say:
I got the egg, you know. Before the miners. Here.

Only - one of the miners told me what the magus does with them. Grinds the shells for a powder that turns men to stone. He sells it to the hill raiders and to whoever fights them. Both sides.

Tomas would lose his place if we [break it]. I'd still be glad. Or we [take it] to the magus and keep our heads down. You choose. I've been brave enough for one week.

options.say: Good. Gods, good. I'll tell Tomas myself. If he's worth anything he'll thank us.
All right. It's not ours to change, I suppose. Let's get out of here before the bell rings again.

steps.goal: Go back to Tomas Fell
steps.say:
She broke it. She broke it and then she told me why, and then she hit me, which was fair.

The magus has thrown me out. I'm going to be a miller's boy. I've never been happier.

steps.goal: Go back to Tomas Fell
steps.say:
You brought it! And Mabli! Both! The magus is pleased - he's even smiling.

Mabli isn't. She won't tell me why. Here - he says I'm to pay you, from the egg-money.

broken.text: Mabli says you're to have this.

quests.title: The Crimson Bargain
quests.offer:
You will listen to me, because nobody else here will. I am Hrodda, daughter of Alrek, chief of the hill-people west of here.

Men in red robes came to my father's fire this spring. Since then his eyes are red too, and so are his warriors'. They are going to burn this town. I do not love this town. But I love my father, and he would not have done this. Will you [help me]? Ask your [captain] if you don't believe me.

topics.captain: Mardoc. The only one of your soldiers who looked at me when I spoke.

quests.summary: Hrodda, daughter of the hill-chief Alrek, says red-robed priests have bewitched her father and his warriors.

steps.goal: Ask Captain Mardoc about the hill-folk
steps.say: The hill-girl? She came in yesterday and the lads laughed at her. I didn't. My scouts have seen red robes among the huts - Crimson initiates, from the south. Whatever they want with the hill-folk, it isn't [peace].

steps.goal: Go to the hill-folk's lands in the west
steps.text: Hill warriors stand at their posts without moving, staring east towards the town. Their eyes glow a dull, steady red.

steps.goal: Break the spell on the hill warriors
steps.text: As each warrior falls the red goes out of their eyes - and in the last one's belt, a scrap of crimson cloth with a sigil stitched on it.

steps.goal: Search Chief Alrek's huts in the north-west
steps.text: In a red hand: 'Burn the town by the new moon and the hills are yours forever. Refuse and we take the girl.' Under it, the hill-chief's mark, pressed in blood.

steps.goal: Confront the Crimson initiate at Alrek's fire
steps.text: The initiate's robes burn up from the hem like paper. Alrek drops to his knees and covers his face.

stages.name: Initiate Vael of the Crimson Hand
stages.announce: A thin smiling man in red rises from Alrek's own seat. 'The chief is mine, stranger. So are his people. So, soon, are you.'

boss.name: Initiate Vael of the Crimson Hand

stages.success: Initiate Vael of the Crimson Hand falls.

steps.goal: Speak with Hrodda at her father's fire
steps.say:
I followed you. Of course I followed you.

He's himself again. He knows what he signed. He'll carry it. But your captain has a bounty on his head - he's raided your farms for twenty years. You've earned that bounty.

I won't stop you. I'll only ask you to [spare him]. Or take the [bounty], and I'll know what your people are.

options.say: Then the hills owe you, and the hills remember. Go to your captain. Tell him Alrek's war is over, and Hrodda's word on it.
...I see. Do it quickly, then. And don't come west again.

steps.goal: Report to Captain Mardoc
steps.say:
No bounty, no head, and a hill-girl's word that the raids are done.

You know what? I'll take that. It's the best deal this post has had in twenty years. Here - from the garrison.

steps.goal: Report to Captain Mardoc
steps.say:
So that's Alrek. Twenty years of raids, and he ends in a sack.

The girl's gone back to the hills. The lads say she'll make a worse chief than her father ever did. We'll see. Here's your bounty.

peace.text: From the garrison - and Hrodda left this for you at the gate.

quests.title: Wargs on the West Road
quests.offer:
Grey wargs on the west road - more of them every week, and bolder. They run down my pickets in pairs.

Will you [thin the wargs]?
quests.summary: Grey wargs are running down the garrison's pickets on the west road.

steps.goal: Thin the gray wargs on the west road about 600 m south-west of Castellan Rhydderch
Tell Castellan Rhydderch
steps.say: Good. The wargs used to keep to the high crags. Something's driven them down. Something in the west.

quests.title: The Beaked Brood
quests.offer:
Enraged cockatrices all over the mine hills, and a big cock-bird called Trimbeak who leads them. They turn a man's blood to stone with a look.

Will you [break the brood]?
quests.summary: Enraged cockatrices led by Trimbeak hold the old mine hills.

steps.goal: Kill the enraged cockatrices about 250 m south-west of Tomas Fell
Kill Trimbeak
Tell Tomas Fell
steps.say: Trimbeak, dead. His three brothers will want words with you. Glim, Slim and Grim, the miners call them.

quests.title: Glimbeak, Slimbeak and Grimbeak
quests.offer:
Trimbeak's three brothers roost on the beak rocks north of the mine. While they live, the brood comes back.

Will you [finish the brothers]? Bring friends who don't mind being stared at.
quests.summary: Trimbeak's three brothers roost on the beak rocks north of the old mine.

steps.goal: Kill Glimbeak about 200 m south-east of Tomas Fell
Kill Slimbeak
Kill Grimbeak
Tell Tomas Fell
steps.say: All three. The hills are yours, friend. The miners will go back in the spring.

quests.title: The Red Road
quests.offer:
The forest road from Snowdonia Station to the west - the smugglers call it the Red Road, for the cords. They run carts up it at night, west to the hill fort.

Will you [stop a cart]? I want to know what's in them.
quests.summary: Smugglers run carts west along the forest road at night.

steps.goal: Fight through the forest smugglers about 330 m north of Captain Mardoc
Search a smugglers' cart
steps.text: Sacks of bones - big, old, wrapped in rotted mail - and a tally: 'Badon, by the Bishop's leave. To Dinas Emrys, for the pit.'

steps.goal: Tell Captain Mardoc
steps.say:
Badon's bones. The Abbey in the south was sending them north - and they're still coming, Bishop or no Bishop.

To Dinas Emrys. What does a pit want with Arthur's dead?

quests.title: Trackers in the Trees
quests.offer:
The smugglers have trackers - woodsmen who know every path - and they've been picking off my patrols from the trees.

Will you [hunt the hunters]?
quests.summary: The smugglers' trackers are picking off the garrison's patrols from the trees.

steps.goal: Hunt the forest trackers about 250 m north of Captain Mardoc
Tell Captain Mardoc
steps.say: My patrols can walk the road again. Now for the one who sends them.

quests.title: The Forest Chief
quests.offer:
The smugglers' master calls himself the Forest Chief. His den's in the north woods. Kill him and the Red Road closes.

Will you [close the road]? Bring friends.
quests.summary: The Forest Chief runs the smugglers of the Red Road from his den in the north woods.

steps.goal: Defeat the Forest Chief about 460 m north of Captain Mardoc
Search the Forest Chief's den

clue.name: a ledger in a locked box

steps.text: 'Delivered to the Pit-Warden at Dinas Emrys: bones of Badon, forty sacks; hill-tribe tithe, paid in red cord. The Lady wants the pit open by the turning of the year.'

steps.goal: Bring the ledger to Captain Mardoc
steps.say:
The Pit-Warden. The Lady. By the turning of the year.

The Castellan has to see this. And the bard.

quests.title: The Prophet's Graves
quests.offer:
The druids in the old graves south of the hill country were Merlin's own students. They were buried with stones carved with his prophecies. Now they walk, and the stones are being taken.

Will you [visit the graves]?
quests.summary: Merlin's students walk from their graves, and their prophecy-stones are being taken.

steps.goal: Lay the undead druids to rest about 500 m west of Taliesin the Bard
Search the graves for prophecy-stones

clue.name: a grave with its stone pulled up

steps.text: One stone left, missed by whoever took the others. Ogham: 'Under Emrys's fort the red and the white; under them, the door they came by.'

steps.goal: Bring the stone to Taliesin
steps.say: 'The door they came by.' The dragons came up out of Annwn, child. Everyone forgot that part of the story. Morgana didn't.

quests.title: Red Cords in the South Woods
quests.offer:
Filidh in the south woods have taken the red cord - sacrificers, feeding the pit from a distance with what they bleed. Every song I know says that's how you wake a door.

Will you [stop the bleeding]?
quests.summary: Red-corded filidh sacrificers in the south woods feed the pit at Dinas Emrys.

steps.goal: Kill the filidh sacrificers about 380 m south of Taliesin the Bard
Tell Taliesin
steps.say: Good. Every drop they don't spill is a day the door stays shut.

quests.title: The Cauld Lad
quests.offer:
There's a ghost in the woods by the Station - the Cauld Lad, they call him, a brownie-lad who died of cold a hundred years ago. He's always been harmless. This year he's frozen two travellers solid.

The old songs say you lay a brownie with a gift of clothes. Will you [lay the Cauld Lad]? You may have to make him hold still first.
quests.summary: The Cauld Lad, a brownie ghost near Snowdonia Station, has started freezing travellers.

steps.goal: Take a green cloak from the Station's stores about 20 m north-east of Taliesin the Bard
steps.text: A good green cloak, lined with wool. Warm.

steps.goal: Make the Cauld Lad hold still
steps.text: The Cauld Lad stops. You put the cloak round him. 'Wee lad, wee lad,' he whispers, 'and no more work for me' - and he's gone.

steps.goal: Tell Taliesin
steps.say:
Gone, and warm. That's a better end than most get.

Something in the west woke the cold in him. Everything comes back to that fort.

quests.title: The Necromancers' Cairn
quests.offer:
Two necromancers keep a cairn in the far south-west - not Arawn's men, Morgana's. They write to the Pit-Warden. If anyone knows what's under the fort, they do.

Will you [break the cairn]? Bring friends.
quests.summary: Two of Morgana's necromancers keep a cairn in the far south-west.

steps.goal: Kill the necromancers at the cairn about 740 m west of Taliesin the Bard
Search the necromancers' cairn

clue.name: a letter weighted with a stone

steps.text: 'Pit-Warden - the pit under Emrys's fort is only the near end. The far end is the gate in the lake at Llyn Barfog, where Arthur slew the Afanc. Open the near end and the far end follows. M.'

steps.goal: Bring the letter to Taliesin
steps.say:
Llyn Barfog. Her own lake, where she sits. The near end and the far end.

The fort has to be taken back. Tell the Castellan.

quests.title: The Howling Maidens
quests.offer:
On the crags above Swanton, the howling maidens keen every night. They used to keen for the dead. Now they keen for whoever walks the crags - and they come down to make sure.

Will you [quiet the crags]? Bring friends.
quests.summary: The howling maidens on the crags above Swanton Keep have started coming down for the living.

steps.goal: Quiet the howling maidens about 130 m east of Castellan Rhydderch
Tell Castellan Rhydderch
steps.say: Quiet. First quiet night on the crags this year. Thank you.

quests.title: The Red-Corded Tribes
quests.offer:
The tribes march under red cords now - all of them, my father's warriors too. The shamans tie the cords and say the words.

Kill the shamans and the cords loosen. Will you [cut the cords]?
quests.summary: The hill-tribes march under red cords tied by their shamans.

steps.goal: Fight through the red-corded hill warriors about 850 m north-west of Hrodda Alreksdottir
Kill the hill shamans who tie the cords
Tell Hrodda
steps.say: Some of them have taken the cords off already. I saw my cousin weep. Now - my father.

quests.title: Hill Chief Alrek
quests.offer:
My father stands on the hill by the fort with the red cord round his throat. The Crimson tied it themselves. He doesn't know me.

Beat him down - don't kill him if you can help it - and I'll come up behind you and cut it. Will you [face my father]? Bring friends. He was the best fighter in the hills.
quests.summary: Hill Chief Alrek stands by Dinas Emrys bound by a red cord the Crimson tied themselves.

steps.goal: Beat Hill Chief Alrek down about 1.1 km north-west of Hrodda Alreksdottir
steps.text: Alrek falls to his knees. Hrodda runs in with her knife and cuts the cord at his throat.

steps.goal: Speak with Hrodda at Snowdonia Station
steps.say:
He's breathing. He knows me. He's - crying, I think.

I can [take him home], to the high hills, and the tribes will follow him away from this place. Or he can [stand with the garrison] when they come for the fort - he knows every stone of it.

options.say: Home, then. The tribes go with us. That's a hundred spears the Crimson won't have.
Then the Alrek of the hills fights for Albion again. The Castellan will want to hear it.

quests.title: Dinas Emrys
quests.offer:
The bard's told me what's under that fort, and the smugglers' ledger tells me when. We can't take it alone - but we can bleed it, and when the garrison's ready, every red cord you've cut will count.

Will you [break the gate]? Bring the strongest friends you have.
quests.summary: The Crimson hold Dinas Emrys, the hill fort over the dragons' pit.

steps.goal: Break the hill guards at the fort's gate about 480 m west of Castellan Rhydderch
Cut down the crimson acolytes inside the walls
Look down into the pit

clue.name: the edge of a great pit

steps.text: The pit goes down further than the light. Red stone on one wall, white on the other - scales, as big as shields, fused into the rock. At the bottom, very far down, something glows.

steps.goal: Tell Castellan Rhydderch
steps.say:
Scales. Red and white. So the tale's true.

The garrison will take that fort, and soon. When we do, you'll be there.

quests.title: The Dragons' Pit
quests.offer:
The Pit-Warden stands at the edge of the pit, singing it open. When the door opens here, the far end opens at Llyn Barfog, and Annwn walks into Albion.

I'll come with you. Bards don't fight, but they can sing a door shut. Will you [close the pit]? Bring everyone.

topics.taliesin: He smiles. 'I was Gwion once, and a grain of wheat, and a salmon, and a wren. Now I'm an old man with a harp. It's been a long life.'

quests.summary: The Pit-Warden sings the dragons' pit under Dinas Emrys open, a door to Annwn.

steps.goal: Go to the edge of the dragons' pit about 1.1 km north-west of Taliesin the Bard
steps.text: The singing comes up out of the pit like heat. The Pit-Warden turns.

steps.goal: Defeat the Pit-Warden of Dinas Emrys
steps.text: The Pit-Warden falls. Taliesin's voice rises over the pit - and slowly, the glow at the bottom goes out.

steps.goal: Speak with Taliesin at the pit's edge
steps.say:
It's shut. This end. The far end is in Morgana's own lake, and she'll have felt it close.

Two scales broke loose from the walls when the song took hold: one red, one white. Take [the red] - Albion's dragon - or [the white], to know your enemy. I'll keep the other.

options.say: The red. Uther's dragon, and Arthur's. Wear it well.
The white. Cold, isn't it? That's Golestandt. Remember the cold when you meet him.
